context.description: Step 03: Design and write tests for ENV-04 frontend UI changes.

task.description:
Write a test spec and frontend tests for ENV-04. All MUST acceptance criteria must have coverage. Required test cases:

TC-ENV04-01: TestEnvironmentBanner renders when tenant_type='test' — renders with 'TEST ENVIRONMENT' text and production tenant name.

TC-ENV04-02: TestEnvironmentBanner does NOT render when tenant_type='production' — no TEST ENVIRONMENT text in DOM.

TC-ENV04-03: TestEnvironmentBanner shows fallback '(unknown)' when production_tenant_display_name is absent.

TC-ENV04-04: ConfirmPromoteModal shows exact prescribed text and can be confirmed.

TC-ENV04-05: ConfirmPromoteModal is cancelled and promote API is NOT called.

TC-ENV04-06: Promote to Production button is shown on DefinitionEditorPage only when tenant_type='test' AND status='ACTIVE'.

TC-ENV04-07: Promote to Production button is hidden when tenant_type='production'.

TC-ENV04-08: TenantsPage renders [TEST] badge for test-type tenants and NOT for production tenants.

Write tests using the existing frontend test framework (check web/tests/ for patterns — Vitest/React Testing Library likely). Write test spec to web/tests/specs/ENV-04.md and test files to web/tests/. Run: pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint && python tools/lint_handoffs.py (all must exit 0).

result.summary: REWORK(1/3): Added TC-ENV04-07b (Promote button absent when def.status=DRAFT on test tenant) to DefinitionEditorPage.promote.test.tsx. Added TC-ENV04-09 (AC-5 instance list backend-enforced tenant isolation: useInstances called without tenant_id filter) to new file InstanceBoardPage.tenant-isolation.test.tsx. Updated web/tests/specs/ENV-04.md to include both new TCs (10 total). pnpm type-check: exit 0. pnpm lint: exit 0. Committed to feature/WF02-env04-20260812.
